finalText:
Big but mostly mechanical. 1,290 hits sit across 94 files. About 1,011 are plain variables and safe to rename.

Five places must keep `account_id`:

| Where | Hits | Why |
|---|---|---|
| `docs/openapi.yaml` | 5 | Public contract, frozen and versioned |
| `lib/serialize.js` WIRE values | 1 | Public JSON keys clients read |
| `vendor/reporting-sdk/` | 12 | Regenerated by `vendor:refresh`, edits wiped |
| `migrations/*.sql` | 37 | Already applied, editing breaks the down step |
| SQL strings in services | 125 | Real column name, needs a new migration |

Two soft spots remain. `req.session.account_id` has 100 hits and is set outside this repo. `lib/audit.js` writes the key into stored log lines.
